description.summary: You fill a target’s mind with peaceful thoughts, lulling them into a deep slumber, the images are so strong they can even affect those who would normally have lost all sense.
description.value: You fill a target’s mind with peaceful thoughts, lulling them into a deep slumber, the images are so strong they can even affect those who would normally have lost all sense. The target of this spell receives the Sleep status effect. The victim falls into a magical slumber, can only be woken with a standard action or after receiving damage. The target of this spell must have 13 HD or less to be affected by this spell. As this spell is filled with light-based energy, it can affect creatures with the undead type or cie’th subtype, even when they are normally immune to mind-affecting spells and/or the sleep status. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for March 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
